screen.intro: Active habits and counters appear on Home. Archive items to hide them without losing history or day notes — restore anytime from Archive below.
screen.countersSubtitle: Daily quantities with optional targets — totals reset each day
screen.countersEmpty: No active counters. Add one to track water, steps, or anything countable.
screen.habitsEmpty: No active habits. Add one for meditation, reading, or any daily routine.
screen.archiveSubtitle: Hidden from Home — history kept until deleted
screen.archiveEmpty: Nothing archived. Archive a counter or habit to pause it without deleting its history.

validation.incrementsRequired: Enter at least one positive number (e.g. 5, 10)
validation.dailyTargetPositive: Daily target must be a positive whole number
validation.dailyGoalPositive: Daily goal must be a positive number of minutes
validation.intervalMin1: Interval must be at least 1 day
validation.reminderMinutesNonNegative: Reminder minutes must be zero or more
validation.timeRangeFormat: Enter valid times in HH:mm format, e.g. 06:00
validation.timeRangeRequiredForVisibility: Set a time range before limiting visibility

confirm.archiveBody: "{{name}}" will be hidden from Home. You can restore it from Archive later.
confirm.deleteBody: "{{name}}" and all its history and day notes will be removed permanently.

counterFields.sectionDescription: Quick buttons add to today's total (resets at midnight). Daily target is optional.
counterFields.quickButtonsEmptyHint: Add at least one button below.
counterFields.streakSectionDescription: Shown under the counter name when you have a daily target.
counterFields.showStreakHint: Counts consecutive days you hit the daily target — even before today's total reaches it

habitFields.streakSectionDescription: Shown under the habit name — motivating before you check off.
habitFields.showStreakHint: Success streak under the name — shown even before today's check-off
habitFields.repeatSectionDescription: Which days this habit is due. Off days stay off the Habits list and do not break streaks.
habitFields.enterIntervalHint: Enter how often this habit repeats.
habitFields.timeWindowSectionDescription: Optional. Limit when the habit shows on the Habits tab, and set a reminder before it starts.
habitFields.onlyShowDuringWindowHint: Hidden outside this time on Habits
habitFields.everyNDaysReminderUnavailableHint: Reminders are not available for every-N-days schedules yet.

habitSoundFields.soundHint: Choose a bundled meditation or focus track.
habitSoundFields.noTracksBundledHint: No tracks bundled yet. Add MP3 files to assets/sounds/ in the project, then rebuild the app.
habitSoundFields.couldNotPlaySoundMissingBody: This track is missing from the app build. Reinstall the latest dev APK.
habitSoundFields.playOnceHint: Timer stops and logs your session when the track ends — good for guided meditation.
habitSoundFields.loopHint: Sound loops until you tap Stop.

counterWidget.replacesTotalHint: Replaces today's logged {{unit}} with a single total.
counterWidget.invalidTotalBody: Enter a whole number zero or greater.
